title: Implement WP8 native-print feasibility probe
description: Follow team/PLAN.md, team/PROTOCOL.md, DELEGATION.md Common rules and applicable child plan; preserve current dirty work. This board records unfinished acceptance/repair, not permission to rebuild existing features. Inspect current implementation and earlier evidence first; fix only reproduced gaps in owned files, record exact commands/results and fail-first controls, and report CLAIMED. No installs, new packages, commits, pushes, publication, real-library access or destructive cleanup. Before expensive checks, acquire exclusive registered path node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/team-serial-check-slot via team.py files add; if another live task owns it, do independent work or hand off rather than overlap runs. Retain full logs and use pinned Node/offline serial Rust/production-preview Playwright. Independent review is required. Execute L1 in 05-layout/PLAN.md. Native printing files are absent at board setup. Use only already installed/approved locked bridge crates; no package installs or lock expansion. Produce exact bridge proposal and isolated render_pdf probe with escaped schema markup, disabled imported script/IPC/navigation and no remote/file loads. Prove actual Letter/A4 paginated searchable text, explicit breaks, font/image readiness, media/tables/notes and mixed direction with rendered pages. Native API presence or createPDF tall viewport is insufficient. Integrate lib.rs/smoke/Cargo/capability lines only narrowly as approved. Run isolated diagnostic build and python3 scripts/native-print-smoke.py --probe, with distinct negative controls. If infeasible, retain legacy exporter and document exact stop; do not switch public export. Write the task report to docs/agent-work/2026-10-24-team-reconciliation/wp8.md.
